characters.summary: Big Bird is a large, gentle avian creature who generally avoids combat but possesses considerable reach due to his large size and bird-like agility. He relies on defensive posturing, evasion, and occasionally assistance from his large community of friends.

sources.supports: Basic attributes, size, and character background.

feats.claim: Reached high shelves and objects utilizing his height of over eight feet.

campaignTags.claim: Stands eight feet two inches tall.

unknowns: Actual combat capabilities under duress are largely untested as he is a peaceful character.

characters.summary: Bobo the Bear is a burly, world-weary bear who works as a security guard. He uses his physical strength and basic security training to handle disturbances.
weaknesses: Prone to exhaustion and lacks high-level combat agility
limitations: Lacks advanced martial arts or ranged attacks

sources.supports: Role as security guard and physical attributes as a bear.

feats.claim: Acted as a physical bouncer and security guard on Muppets Tonight.

unknowns: Performance in actual combat scenarios outside of security work.

characters.summary: Boober Fraggle is cautious, pessimistic, and deeply averse to physical danger. He fights primarily through avoidance, laundry-based defense, and hiding.
weaknesses: Extreme anxiety and fear of sickness or danger
limitations: Refuses to engage in direct combat

sources.supports: Personality traits, laundry obsession, and aversion to danger.

feats.claim: Avoided numerous hazardous situations in Fraggle Rock through caution and hiding.

characters.summary: Bruno the Trashman is a massive, heavy-duty individual who carries large heavy containers and utilizes brute strength to manage debris and obstacles.

sources.supports: Role, heavy lifting capabilities, and physical build.

feats.claim: Carried massive loads of trash consistently throughout Sesame Street.

characters.summary: Cantus is a mystical piper who uses music and magical resonance from his pipe to influence emotions, open pathways, and guide others.
weaknesses: Relies on his pipe to channel his abilities
limitations: Powers are non-lethal and centered on harmony rather than direct combat

sources.supports: Magical musical abilities and role in Fraggle Rock.

feats.claim: Used his pipe to alter environments and inspire Fraggles.

campaignTags.claim: Uses magical music to influence reality and create effects.

unknowns: Direct combat performance against offensive attackers.

characters.summary: Clifford is the cool, laid-back bass player and host who handles chaotic situations with smooth talk and casual authority rather than physical confrontation.
limitations: Not trained in martial arts or combat

sources.supports: Role as host and musician on Muppets Tonight.

feats.claim: Managed chaotic television studio environments through hosting and negotiation.

unknowns: Combat capabilities in a hostile engagement.

characters.summary: Constantine is a master criminal and expert escape artist who employs stealth, deception, espionage, and physical combat tactics to achieve his goals.
weaknesses: Arrogance leading to underestimates of opponents
limitations: Relies heavily on deception rather than overwhelming brute force

sources.supports: Role as world's most dangerous frog and criminal mastermind.

feats.claim: Escaped from a high-security Gulag prison and coordinated an international heist tour.

notableResults.note: Amushed Kermit and framed him to assume his identity.

campaignTags.claim: Successfully impersonated Kermit the Frog and infiltrated high-security prisons.
Utilized stealth and disguise to commit international crimes.

unknowns: Performance in prolonged direct combat against superhuman fighters.

characters.summary: Cookie Monster is an insatiable, high-energy monster who uses ferocious physical momentum, rapid charging, and immense appetite-driven focus to break through barriers and obstacles.
weaknesses: Easily distracted by baked goods and cookies
limitations: Lack of discipline outside of food acquisition

sources.supports: Character traits, strength, and chaotic appetite.

feats.claim: Smashed through doors and devoured large quantities of objects instantly.

campaignTags.claim: Large, robust monster stature capable of overpowering standard obstacles.

unknowns: Combat effectiveness when cookies are entirely absent from the environment.
